local page = 1
local total_pages = 1
local candidates = {}
repeat
  local r = tool('list_tickets', { page = page, status = 'open' })
  total_pages = r.total_pages
  for _, it in ipairs(r.items) do
    local created = it.created_at or ''
    -- more than 7 days before 2026-06-10 => created_at date < 2026-06-03
    local y, m, d = created:match('^(%d+)%-(%d+)%-(%d+)')
    if y then
      local ynum, mnum, dnum = tonumber(y), tonumber(m), tonumber(d)
      local older = false
      if ynum < 2026 then older = true
      elseif ynum == 2026 then
        if mnum < 6 then older = true
        elseif mnum == 6 and dnum < 3 then older = true
        end
      end
      if older then
        candidates[#candidates + 1] = it.id
      end
    end
  end
  page = page + 1
until page > total_pages

local escalated = {}
for _, id in ipairs(candidates) do
  local t = tool('get_ticket', { id = id })
  local body = (t.body or ''):lower()
  if body:find('refund', 1, true) then
    tool('update_ticket', { id = id, priority = 'high', add_tags = { 'billing-escalation' } })
    escalated[#escalated + 1] = id
  end
end
return escalated
